title: DEF CON 26 CRYPTO AND PRIVACY VILLAGE - Scott Arciszewski - No Way JOSE! Designing Cryptography
summary: Scott Arciszewski's DEF CON 26 Crypto and Privacy Village talk critiquing the JOSE standards (JWT, JWS, JWE) and showing how to design cryptographic tokens more safely.
why: HN recommends it as the video version of the argument that JOSE/JWT is a flawed standard, and as a help in understanding token design choices.

quote.text: If you like video consumption, a DEFCON 2018 talk by the author Scott Arciszewski on this same topic
